abstract: A case of testicular choriocarcinoma is reported in which blood mixed stools and haemoptysis were the presenting manifestations as the patient never told about the testicular swelling to his parents. Orchidectomy was performed but the patient presented again with massive hematemesis due to gastric perforation secondary to gastric metastasis. The size of the testis at diagnosis was approximately 12 x 7 cm. This was also unusual as testicular choriocarcinoma presents as a small mass. The patient eventually died of the complications within one month of diagnosis.
abstract_ja: 精巣腫瘍の症例を報告する。血便と喀血が初発症状であり、患者は精巣の腫脹を両親に伝えていなかった。精巣摘除術を施行したが、胃転移による胃穿孔から大量の吐血をきたした。診断時の精巣サイズは約12×7cmであった。精巣絨毛癌は通常小さな腫瘤として発症するため、これは非典型的であった。患者は診断後1か月以内に合併症で死亡した。
